title: "Image Read Tool Failure: 'B is not a function' Error"
body:
**Bug Description**
An issue with the image read tool. "Error: B is not a function". Claude code, MacOS taking a screenshot. Claude code in the terminal. Tried making the image smaller and also converting from png to jpg. None of these strategies worked.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: tmux
- Version: 1.0.3
- Feedback ID: 8bf5674e-dd02-4ab1-b4cd-0db80084fddd
